# Pull request

## Summary

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior.

## Verification

List the exact commands run and their results.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and follows the existing design contract.
- [ ] Commit messages use Conventional Commits.
- [ ] Tests cover behavior changes or the reason they do not is documented.
- [ ] `nix flake check` passes.
- [ ] Documentation and release notes are updated when behavior changes.
- [ ] No credentials, `.env` files, generated install state, or run artifacts
      are included.
